TAL_AXES_WORK_AXE_EYE.why: Its Proficiency Bonus on damage to an unattended wooden object is applied by the Attack an object action with an axe (combat/ext/objects.py, combat/rules/feature_blocks.d/sysv2_objects.json). The Advantage on breaking checks is the GM's: no break check exists.

TAL_AXES_GATE_SPLITTING_BLOW.why: Offered as Attack an object variants that spend 1 CP, 1 Stamina or Martial Focus (combat/ext/objects.py): +2d8 and the Damage Threshold cut by Proficiency Bonus.

TAL_BERSERKER_GREAT_DESTROYER.why: Double damage to objects with a melee weapon attack while holding Martial Focus is applied by Attack an object (combat/ext/objects.py). The Advantage on breaking checks is the GM's: no break check exists.

TAL_IRON_FIST_IRON_MERIDIAN_BODY.why: Its Proficiency Bonus on an Unarmed Strike's damage to an unattended object is applied by Attack an object with an Unarmed Strike (combat/ext/objects.py).

TAL_IRON_FIST_WORLD_TEMPERING_BODY.why: Unarmed Strikes ignore an object's Damage Threshold while holding Martial Focus: applied by Attack an object with an Unarmed Strike (combat/ext/objects.py).
